name: Scarsdale Public Library - Mah Jongg Open Play
description: Library open play: "the National Mah Jongg League (NMJL) 2026 card and rules"; 3- or 4-hand games and Siamese variants. Some tables accommodate beginners but no formal instruction is provided. The library supplies a limited number of sets; registration may be required and sessions can fill.
schedule: Periodic sessions in Meeting Room North South; see library calendar for dates.

name: JCC Mid-Westchester
description: Community center hosting drop-in game sessions that include mahjong and a mahjong fundraising evening run with The Parlour. Its pages do not say American or NMJL.
schedule: Directory/search snippets: drop-in game sessions Tuesdays and Wednesdays 1:00-3:00 PM (not confirmed on the JCC page this run).

name: The Parlour
description: Mahjong classes, private group sessions and events started by Scarsdale residents Hadley Miller and Martha Kaiser. Own website/page not found this run, so American/NMJL is unconfirmed.
schedule: Six-week private classes reported by ABC7; JCCMW event Nov 12 2026 play is offered through The Parlour.
